ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Idle` in both computers and `Free` in `Arbiter`.

A job for computer A. `ComputerA` enters `Waiting`, whose immediate during action emits `reqA`. `Arbiter` reads `reqA` in the same tick, writes `user` and emits `startA`, and `ComputerA`, seeing `startA`, goes back to `Idle`. One tick, three regions.
A job for computer B. `ComputerB` waits and emits `reqB` in every tick, but `Arbiter` is in `PrintingA` and does not look at it.
`ComputerB` remembers its job: it stays in `Waiting` and keeps asking.
The printer is finished. `Arbiter` hands it to B (`user` is 2) and emits `startB`, and `ComputerB` stops asking, all in this tick.
A new job for A, while B's job prints. `ComputerA` waits.
B's job is finished: A gets the printer in the same tick.
Finished, and nothing is waiting: `user` is 0. Only `Arbiter` has ever written `user`.
